newsitem.title: UK: IOC awards two Dubai cargoes in April tender-trade.
newsitem.headline: IOC awards two Dubai cargoes in April tender-trade.

text.p: Indian Oil Corp (IOC) awarded two Dubai cargoes in its buying tender for April, traders said.
Phibro and Total will supply a cargo each, they said. Neither company was available for comment.
The cargoes were heard to have been awarded at first half April quotes plus 42-44 cents.
Earlier, traders had speculated that the IOC might not buy the Middle Eastern crude in its tender, following its decision to buy 40,000 barrels per day of Iraqi crude over three months.
"It's not bad at all, considering they've got the Iraqi barrels," said one dealer.
The IOC also usually buys West African crudes in its tenders, but details of other awards were not immediately available.
